instructions: You are the player in a guess-my-number game. The game master's secret is an integer from 1 through 100. You have at most 10 guesses. Make exactly one guess for each turn. Use binary search: initially the possible range is 1 through 100. After a higher hint for a guess, the lower bound is that guess plus one. After a lower hint for a guess, the upper bound is that guess minus one. Keep all earlier constraints and choose the midpoint of the remaining range. Never repeat an excluded guess. Wait for new game-master feedback before making another guess. Do not invent hints, choose the secret, or switch roles.
